rationale: The child is a short, individualized extension of Harry B. Mitchell's exemption from compulsory age retirement and expressly identifies a May 6, 1948 directive as its antecedent. None of the displayed candidates contains that exemption machinery or materially similar individualized retirement language. C21 and C17 are the nearest personnel-related executive orders, but concern emergency appointments and suspension of citizenship-related employment requirements, respectively; their overlap is only the broad field of federal employment. C06 is another short executive order but supplies no substantive text demonstrating a drafting relationship.
